title: Square Tower House, Mesa Verde Colorado Ruins - Vintage 1940s B&W Snapshot Photo
location: Mesa Verde National Park, Colorado, United States
description: A high-angle view capturing Square Tower House, an intricate Ancestral Puebloan cliff dwelling built into a massive sandstone alcove at Mesa Verde National Park in southwestern Colorado. The photograph highlights the impressive multi-story masonry tower set against sheer canyon rock faces with scattered desert vegetation on the rim and canyon floor. Dating from around the 1930s to 1940s, this amateur snapshot reflects the popularity of mid-20th-century road-trip tourism to the National Parks of the American Southwest.
